He will ask Washington not to enforce the MATCH Act, which would force allies to adopt US-style export controls or face unilateral curbs. The bill is attached to the US defense budget and faces a mid-December vote. ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet separately told Semafor that a full China ban would push China to build domestic rivals.
headlines: Netherlands vows to resist US MATCH Act on ASML China sales; ASML CEO warns a total ban would backfire

headline: AI selloff deepens: Nasdaq falls ~4%, Nvidia drops 8.7% and AMD 9.6% on Nov. 25
summary: AI Weekly reports the Nasdaq fell 3.98% on Nov. 25 as the AI-stock selloff deepened. Nvidia dropped 8.69% and AMD 9.56%. S&P's Nov. 26 note put Nvidia shares down about 38% since Oct. 6.

headline: California bans Waymo robotaxis from state freeways over safety incidents, and Waymo suspends freeway rides in all markets
summary: California regulators pulled Waymo driverless taxis off freeways, calling them an 'imminent hazard' after traffic incidents including a robotaxi rolling onto trolley tracks, and Waymo temporarily suspended freeway rides across markets. Sources note Waymo says its robotaxis crash less than humans, and coverage varies on the scope and duration of the restrictions.
